name: myconid
description: a Myconid (Fall from Heaven), a squat walking mushroom man: a huge domed rust-red mushroom cap with big cream spots and pale gills underneath for a head, two small round glowing yellow eyes under the cap rim and no mouth, a thick pale beige fibrous stalk body, lumpy root-like arms with root-claw fingers, stubby root feet, little clusters of teal-glowing mushrooms on both shoulders, a few solid round pale yellow-green spore balls touching the cap edge, and a heavy knobbly club of pale petrified mushroom stalk in his RIGHT hand
hands: the knobbly club stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and his left hand is an empty root-claw fist on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, the stalk body leans back, the knobbly club is lifted up beside the mushroom cap with its knobbed head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the club cocked behind the cap with its knobbly head hanging down behind the shoulders, the left root-claw hand tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-left, the stalk body whips forward, the arm sweeps over and the club is level, its knobbly head pointing to the lower-left
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-left, the knobbly club head smashing down-left, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the left root-claw hand swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the club carries on down until its knobbly head nearly touches the ground at the lower-left, the stalk body twisted, the mushroom cap tilting
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the club lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; the mushroom cap snaps back toward the upper-right, the yellow eyes squeezed shut, the stalk body jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the left root-claw hand flung out to the right, the club arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the club dipping, the left root-claw hand still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the left root-claw hand drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, the stalk body slumps forward, the mushroom cap droops, the club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's knobbly head resting on the ground, the left root-claw arm hanging
death.4: falling back: the stalk body tips back toward the upper-right, the club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right, the big spotted mushroom cap resting on the ground behind him; the knobbly club lies on the ground at the lower-left
death.6: bounce: the cap and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the teal shoulder mushrooms settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, the yellow eyes closed, the spotted cap on the ground, the knobbly club on the ground beside him
